plan: Store the workspace as one deep-copied dict tree; expose to_data() as a deep copy so internal state can never leak or be mutated externally.

Implement a single recursive generator _walk yielding (item, depth) in document order; build total_word_count, unresolved_markers, and outline on top of it so all reads share one deterministic traversal.
Count note words by first stripping [[?identifier]] marker tokens (regex) then counting \b\w+\b runs; add each reference's declared word_count.
Collect unresolved identifiers from note-text marker tokens and from reference 'unresolved' lists into a set, returned sorted lexicographically.
Render the outline as the title plus one line per item with two spaces per nesting level (direct children of the workspace are level 1) and '<kind>: <title>'.

Implement move with full validation before any mutation: string-id checks, item lookup (list + position), destination resolution ('workspace' literal or section/group id), non-container rejection, self-or-descendant cycle rejection, and index bounds 0..len(destination); only after all checks pass, splice the item out and insert/append, so failed moves leave to_data() byte-identical.
mechanisms: deep-copy isolation at construction and export
marker-stripping regex word count with per-kind contribution
set-union plus sorted output for marker identifiers
validate-then-mutate relocation with descendant-containment cycle check
